name: ZTools Official Tool Registry
description: Curated catalog of tools, extensions, and automated capabilities for ZAgent and ZEngine autonomous systems.

categories.name: Developer & Git Workflows
categories.description: Code navigation, repository analysis, changelog generation, and filesystem utilities.

categories.name: Mobile & Android
categories.description: Project scaffolding, mobile build systems, and Android development tools.

categories.name: Browser & Web Automation
categories.description: Chrome automation, DOM inspection, navigation, and web interaction tools.

categories.name: Search & Research
categories.description: Multi-engine web search, content scraping, and information retrieval.

categories.name: AI & Generative Media
categories.description: Image generation, music synthesis, and generative AI integrations.

categories.name: Video Editing
categories.description: Cut, join, resize, convert, compress, caption and inspect videos with FFmpeg.

categories.name: Audio
categories.description: Extract, clean up, mix, de-silence and visualise audio with FFmpeg.

categories.name: Online Media
categories.description: Look up, download and transcribe videos from YouTube and 1000+ other sites.

tools.name: Workspace Tree Visualizer
tools.description: Generate clean, token-efficient directory trees for agents. Automatically respects .gitignore and filters out vendor, build, and binary directories.

tools.name: Git Conventional Changelog
tools.description: Parse Conventional Commits (feat, fix, perf, docs), calculate next SemVer bump (major, minor, patch), and generate clean release notes.

tools.name: Android Project Scaffold
tools.description: Offline Android project generator targeting Kotlin & Jetpack Compose with pinned stable toolchain, Gradle wrapper, and Material 3 templates.

tools.name: ZPilot Web Search
tools.description: Multi-engine web search tool for ZAgent. Search Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Brave, or Yahoo using your authenticated browser session.

tools.name: ZPilot Webpage Reader
tools.description: Read JavaScript-rendered web pages using your active browser session. Returns distraction-free Markdown, text, or DOM nodes with link extraction.

tools.name: ZPilot Browser Automation
tools.description: Direct browser automation bridge for ZAgent. Navigate, read, click, type, fill forms, take screenshots, and inspect DOM inside Google Chrome.

tools.name: Browser AI Image Generator
tools.description: Generate or edit images through ChatGPT / DALL-E directly in the user's signed-in browser session, returning saved image files.

sample_call.prompt: Futuristic cyberpunk workstation with glowing holographic monitors in high resolution

tools.name: Browser AI Music Generator
tools.description: Synthesize musical tracks and background scores through Gemini / browser audio tools, supporting custom genres, instruments, and style prompts.

sample_call.prompt: Uplifting synthwave retro groove with 80s drums and melodic arpeggio

tools.name: Media Downloader
tools.description: Download videos or audio from YouTube and 1000+ sites via yt-dlp, with pytubefix as a YouTube fallback. Quality, sections, subtitles and playlists.

tools.name: Online Media Lookup
tools.description: Inspect an online video or playlist without downloading: title, channel, duration, views, chapters, qualities and caption languages.

tools.name: Video Transcript
tools.description: Fetch the transcript of an online video from its subtitles or automatic captions, as clean text, timestamped text or SRT.

tools.name: Media Probe
tools.description: Inspect any video or audio file: duration, container, streams, codecs, resolution, frame rate, bitrate, rotation and chapters.

tools.name: Video Frame Extractor
tools.description: Pull still frames or a labelled contact sheet out of a video so vision-capable agents can see what happens in it.

tools.name: Scene Detector
tools.description: Detect cuts and scene changes in a video and list each scene's start, end and length, with optional thumbnails.

tools.name: Media Trimmer
tools.description: Cut a clip out of a video or audio file between two timestamps, frame-accurately or instantly without re-encoding.

tools.name: Media Splitter
tools.description: Split a video or audio file into parts: fixed-length segments, N equal parts, or at chosen timestamps.

tools.name: Media Merger
tools.description: Join videos or audio files end to end. Identical formats are joined instantly; mixed sizes, frame rates and codecs are normalised automatically.

tools.name: Video Resizer & Reframer
tools.description: Resize videos or change their aspect ratio (16:9 → 9:16 for Shorts/Reels/TikTok) by cropping, padding or a blurred background.

tools.name: Video Rotate & Flip
tools.description: Rotate a video 90/180/270 degrees and/or mirror it horizontally or vertically.

tools.name: Speed & Reverse
tools.description: Speed up, slow down or reverse video and audio, keeping voices at their natural pitch.

tools.name: Watermark & Captions
tools.description: Overlay a logo and/or text on a video with position, size, opacity and an optional time range.

tools.name: Subtitle Embedder
tools.description: Add SRT, VTT or ASS subtitles to a video, burned into the picture or as a selectable subtitle track.

tools.name: Media Converter
tools.description: Convert video and audio between formats and codecs (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, MP3, WAV, FLAC, H.265, AV1), with optional downscaling.

tools.name: Video Compressor
tools.description: Shrink videos to a target size (e.g. under 25 MB for Discord or email) with two-pass encoding, or to a quality level.

tools.name: GIF & WebP Maker
tools.description: Turn a video clip into a high-quality animated GIF (optimised palette) or a smaller animated WebP.

tools.name: Slideshow Maker
tools.description: Create a slideshow video from images with smooth transitions, any resolution (incl. vertical) and background music.

tools.name: Audio Extractor
tools.description: Extract the soundtrack of a video as MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC or Opus, optionally just a section.

tools.name: Audio Enhancer
tools.description: Clean up audio in videos or audio files: two-pass loudness normalisation (LUFS), volume, fades, noise reduction and rumble filter.

tools.name: Music & Voice-over Mixer
tools.description: Add background music or a voice-over to a video with auto-ducking, looping and fade-out, or replace its soundtrack.

tools.name: Silence Remover
tools.description: Detect pauses in a recording, or cut them out automatically to make tight jump-cut edits of talks, tutorials and podcasts.

tools.name: Waveform & Audiogram
tools.description: Draw audio as a waveform or spectrogram image, or render an audiogram video (animated waveform over an image) for social media.
